notes: Finkelstein 1988 has no pool, pit or grave of this site. The book describes only the fortification wall and the four-room houses (pp. 64, 254, 262-263), and cites the full report as forthcoming. Fig. 86 (p. 254) is a schematic plan of the wall and houses, with a north arrow and scale, but it marks no water or burial feature and the unit's point cannot be placed on it. 'Bedrock was already exposed in the entire center' (p. 64) is not an absence statement.
